# A&S Contracting Services: Business and Service Information

## Business Information
- Company name: A&S Contracting Services
- Type: General contractor
- Location: Warrenton, Missouri 63383, in Warren County. No street address is published.
- Service radius: 50 miles from Warrenton, covering Warren County and central Missouri
- Founded: 2023
- Owner: Blake Alger
- Credentials: Licensed Missouri general contractor, fully insured. No license number is published.
- Clients: residential and commercial
- Phone: (636) 359-7204
- Email: blake@ascontractingservices.com
- Website: https://ascontractingservices.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 8am-3pm

## About
Blake Alger founded A&S Contracting Services in 2023 in Warrenton, Missouri. The company started with a focus on roofing and exterior work and expanded to the full list of services below, including interior work, drywall, and general contracting.

A&S performs its own work. There are no subcontractors, the same crew stays on a project from start to finish, and one accountable team handles every stage. The job site is kept clean every day, and every project ends with a final walkthrough.

More: https://ascontractingservices.com/about/

## How an A&S Project Works
1. On-site visit. A&S looks at the roof, siding, or room in person.
2. Written, itemized estimate. The visit and the estimate are free and carry no obligation. The estimate states the full price, with no hidden fees or upselling, and the quoted price is the final price.
3. Written start window. Start windows and timelines are given in writing.
4. The work, with daily cleanup of the job site.
5. Final walkthrough on every project.

Estimates are scheduled within days of first contact. A&S publishes no prices. Cost depends on square footage, the materials selected, the condition of the existing structure, and the scope of work.

## Timeframes
- Most single-family roof replacements take 1-3 days, weather permitting.
- Siding varies by square footage and home size.
- Interior work depends on scope.

## Services

### Roofing
Installation, repair, tear-off, and full replacement for residential and commercial properties. Includes storm and hail damage repair and insurance claim documentation. Materials on file: architectural asphalt shingles, impact-resistant shingles, and metal roofing.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/roofing/

### Siding
Installation and repair. Materials on file: vinyl, fiber cement, and wood.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/siding/

### Gutters
Seamless aluminum gutter systems: installation, repair, full replacement, cleaning, and maintenance.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/gutters/

### Soffit
Installation and repair. Soffit supports attic ventilation, blocks pests and moisture, and is matched to the roofline.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/soffit/

### Fascia
Installation and replacement, including replacement of rotted boards. Fascia protects the roof edge and is installed with a matched finish.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/fascia/

### Windows & Doors
Energy-efficient replacement windows, patio doors, and entry doors, with weather sealing.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/windows-doors/

### Full Scale Interior Work
Drywall, flooring, painting, trim, custom finishes, room additions, and full interior remodels.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/full-scale-interior-work/

### Exterior Work
Siding, roofing, and gutter integration, and full exterior renovations.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/exterior-work/

### Dry Wall
Installation, finishing, and repair for residential and commercial projects.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/dry-wall/

### General Contracting
Residential and commercial projects managed from planning to completion.
https://ascontractingservices.com/services/general-contracting/

All services: https://ascontractingservices.com/services/

## Insurance Claims
For storm and hail damage, A&S documents the damage with photos, provides a detailed itemized estimate, meets the insurance adjuster on site, and helps the homeowner through the claim.

## Service Areas
A&S serves Warrenton, Wright City, Foristell, Wentzville, Troy, Jonesburg, and Washington, Missouri, plus Warren County and central Missouri.

- Warrenton (ZIP 63383) is the county seat of Warren County. It sits on Interstate 70 at the State Route 47 interchange. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/warrenton/
- Wright City (ZIP 63390) is in Warren County at I-70 mile marker 200. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/wright-city/
- Foristell (ZIP 63348) lies in St. Charles and Warren counties on I-70 between Wright City and Wentzville, with Peruque Creek on its south side. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/foristell/
- Wentzville (ZIP 63385) is in western St. Charles County. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/wentzville/
- Troy (ZIP 63379) is the county seat of Lincoln County, with US 61 east of the city and Route 47 through its north side. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/troy/
- Jonesburg (ZIP 63351) is in eastern Montgomery County at I-70 exit 183. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/jonesburg/
- Washington (ZIP 63090) is in Franklin County on the south bank of the Missouri River. https://ascontractingservices.com/areas/washington/

All service areas: https://ascontractingservices.com/service-areas/
